jobs.title: Newmark Management Consulting Intern
jobs.description:
- Currently studying for a bachelor’s or post graduate degree from a renowned educational institution with a Real Estate/ MIS/ Accounting/Business focus.
- A solid team player who is also an independent thinker.
- A robust analytical skill set, an endless curiosity and a penchant for thinking the impossible.
- Deadline-driven, organized and able to multitask.
- Strong verbal, written and presentation skills.
- Seeking a Summer 2027 Internship
As an Intern, your analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will be placed in the thick of the action as you work side-by-side with some of the best in the business. Every day is different, but our Interns are commonly responsible for data gathering and analysis, industry research, interviewing key clients, working on presentations and attending client meetings. In this role you are exposed to a variety of business issues and the real-world tools used to solve them. Client confidentiality means that we cannot share our clients' names, but if you are passionate about Real Estate, the chances are good that you know our clients.
THIS APPLICATION IS FOR A SUMMER 2027 INTERNSHIP
Our internship program for undergrads and graduate students provides exposure to the real estate industry with continuous, hands-­on learning through full-­time immersion on a Newmark Management Consulting client or internal consulting project.
Your internship begins with a week of onboarding; meeting with colleagues and various departments. After your first week, you are assigned to a current NMRK MC project (and you may be asked to travel to the client site).
Interns benefit from the mentorship of Newmark’s accomplished and experienced staff. While the Internship program is an intense learning experience, our culture also brings the opportunity for additional activities such as meetings with our practice area leaders and social events.

jobs.title: Head of Category Management
jobs.description:
Newmark Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: NMRK), together with its subsidiaries (“Newmark”), is a world leader in commercial real estate, seamlessly powering every phase of the property life cycle. Newmark’s comprehensive suite of services and products is uniquely tailored to each client, from owners to occupiers, investors to founders, and startups to blue-chip companies. Combining the platform’s global reach with market intelligence in both established and emerging property markets, Newmark provides superior service to clients across the industry spectrum. For the twelve months ended June 30, 2026, Newmark generated revenues of more than $3.6 billion. As of June 30, 2026, Newmark and its business partners together operated from over 195 offices with more than 10,000 professionals across four continents. To learn more, visit  nmrk.com  or follow  @newmark .
Job Summary
The principal purpose of the Head of Category Management is to work with Facilities Management and Property Management leaders to help build & continuously improve all Category Management, Strategic Sourcing and Supplier Management activities for Newmark's Facilities & Project Management categories. This role is responsible for both strategy and program development, and the execution of that strategy. The Head of Category Management will primarily support Newmark's Global Corporate Services and Property Management business units. To begin, this role will be a senior-level, individual contributor that over time will hire, develop, and oversee a team of Category Managers.

Additionally, this role will be responsible for supporting all business units in business development efforts where supply chain management is applicable. The individual in this role must have experience in preparing business development materials and presenting to all levels of the organization (external client experience is highly valued).

Internally, the Head of Category Management will collaborate heavily with both the Global Procurement Data & Analytics Lead and on-account procurement professionals in the development of procurement best practices, policies and procedures. A strong background in finance and data analysis will be critical to the success of this role. The role will be responsible for meeting or exceeding all procurement and business unit shared targets and goals and will work with the Chief Procurement Officer to package and communicate those results for dissemination across the executive team(s). Additionally, this individual will work closely with business unit Account Managers, Property Managers and Finance professionals.

Program Development
In partnership with the CPO and business unit Executives develop and enhance a Preferred Supplier program for Facility and Project Management spend categories that delivers exceptional value to our clients and improves the efficiency of our on-account professionals
Partnering with the Global Procurement Head of Data & Analytics, complete deep and thorough spend analyses to drive the prioritization of program goals and targets
Develop a platform for communication of created program materials that is easily accessible by individuals who will leverage the program (think
SharePoint, Power BI, Newmark Intranet, etc.)
Education
- Bachelor’s Degree

Previous Experience
- ﻿﻿The ideal candidate will have spent some time as a consultant or worked for a corporate organization in which they contributed to the development of a new function or product offering
- ﻿﻿Corporate Experience: At least 7 years in a Procurement Category Manager, Sourcing Manager or Center of Excellence role (Facilities related categories a plus)
- ﻿﻿Consulting Experience: At least 3 years working in a General Business
Consulting or Supply Chain Management practice at a reputable consulting firm
- ﻿﻿Experience working for a top Commercial Real Estate Services firm a plus
- ﻿﻿Proven experience in working with, presenting, and influencing all levels of the organization

Certifications
- Professional certification e.g., CPSM, CIPS, C.P.M., PMP, or evidence of continued professional growth

Targeted Competencies
- Strategy development, desire, and ability to implement strategies
- ﻿﻿Understanding of procurement best practices, policies and procedures
- ﻿﻿Building and managing diverse relationships
- ﻿﻿Analytical and Financial acumen
- ﻿﻿Effective Communication (both verbal and written)
- ﻿﻿Creative problem solver
- ﻿﻿Ability to make decisions
- Negotiations
- ﻿﻿Interface with all levels in the organization

Working Conditions:  Normal working conditions with the absence of disagreeable elements
Note:  The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.
Newmark is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Business Development
- Aide business units in business development activities that involve supply chain management
Respond to RFP's including performing complex analyses and preparing RFP
materials such as presentations or speaking agendas for Executives
- ﻿﻿In partnership with the Global Procurement Head of Data & Analytics, proactively and reactively provide business units with spend and supplier information
- Attend and present Client presentations with the ability to articulate the value of Newmark's vision/roadmap and Preferred Supplier Program
- ﻿﻿Collaborate with identified suppliers to sell the vision of the program and gain alignment on shared goals and targets that benefit Newmark, Newmark's Clients, and suppliers
- ﻿﻿Where and when applicable implement Master Agreements with suppliers that outline negotiated commercial terms and SLA's
- ﻿﻿Collaborate with suppliers to develop a roadmap and execute plan at a client and/or local property level. Also partner with on-account professionals to implement roadmap
Hold regularly scheduled Business Reviews with Preferred Suppliers
- Over time, the expectation is that the Preferred Supplier program will go deeper within original in-scope spend categories (ex. Development of Savings targets through RFP's or bringing in new suppliers who better fit the program's needs)
- Additionally, the Procurement Director should continue to expand the categories and geography the program covers
- Hire, train, and develop Category Managers to support the expansion of the Preferred Supplier program

Supplier Relationship Development and Management
In support of the Preferred Supplier program, utilizing detailed spend analytics, identify key suppliers per spend category
- ﻿﻿Collaborate with identified suppliers to sell the vision of the program and gain alignment on shared goals and targets that benefit Newmark, Newmark's Clients, and suppliers
- ﻿﻿Where and when applicable implement Master Agreements with suppliers that outline negotiated commercial terms and SLA's
- ﻿﻿Collaborate with suppliers to develop a roadmap and execute plan at a client and/or local property level. Also partner with on-account professionals to implement roadmap
Hold regularly scheduled Business Reviews with Preferred Suppliers

Continuous Improvement and Program Growth
Over time, the expectation is that the Preferred Supplier program will go deeper within original in-scope spend categories (ex. Development of Savings targets through RFP's or bringing in new suppliers who better fit the program's needs)
- Additionally, the Procurement Director should continue to expand the categories and geography the program covers
- Hire, train, and develop Category Managers to support the expansion of the Preferred Supplier program

jobs.title: Spring11 - Vice President, Asset Management
jobs.description:
Spring11 , an affiliate of Newmark provides a full suite of commercial real estate services to a wide range of clients including some of the world’s largest banks, debt and equity funds, REITs, life insurance companies, brokerages, and investors throughout the United States and Europe. Our team consists of over 600 employees based in New York, Atlanta, Houston, Boca Raton, Kansas City, and Chennai, India.
Spring11 is currently seeking a Vice President to join our growing team to work on a diverse portfolio of transitional commercial loan assets, including ground-up construction, spanning various property types and regions. The Vice President will be tasked with providing asset management support and qualitative and quantitative loan underwriting for a growing portfolio of commercial real estate loans. The ideal candidate for the role has a bachelor’s degree (or higher education) in addition to a minimum of 8 years of commercial real estate experience including direct experience with investment management, asset management, commercial property management, loan origination and/or underwriting.
SKILLS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Real Estate, Economics Finance or other related field required
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in commercial real estate is required, including direct experience with investment management, asset management, commercial property management, loan origination and/or underwriting
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ARGUS experience preferred
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Must possess the financial and quantitative acumen necessary to make well-reasoned, decisive recommendations, as applicable, to senior management
- Ability to work in a fast-paced and quickly changing environment

SALARY RANGE: $100,000 - $150,000 annually
The expected base salary for this position ranges from $100,000 to $150,000 annually.  The actual base salary will be determined on an individualized basis taking into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, education, and, where applicable, licenses or certifications held.  In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package (including health, vision, and dental insurance, paid time off and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching), this position may be eligible for additional types of compensation including discretionary bonuses and other short- and long-term incentives (e.g., deferred cash, equity, etc.).

WORKING CONDITIONS: Normal working conditions with the absence of disagreeable elements
NOTE: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.
Newmark is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES:
- Provide commercial real estate analysis and debt underwriting across all markets and property types
- Monitor each position’s performance relative to underwriting, budget, and covenants within loan documents
- Coordination with and/or management of various third-parties including servicers, borrowers, lenders, and construction consultants, amongst others
- Review and approve draw requests for renovation and ground-up construction projects of varying sizes and scopes ranging from single-use, secondary market transactions to high-profile, trophy projects in major metros
- Monitor performance of transitional/value-add operating properties including performing lease analysis, TI/LC and Renovation draw reviews, and loan covenant testing
- Complete quarterly asset updates for various assets
- Update and/or create credit committee presentation memos for loan modifications
- Work collaboratively to achieve department and firm objectives
- Contribute to the oversight and mentorship of junior staff members to support an expanding Asset Management platform

jobs.description:
Spring11: Spring11, an affiliate of Newmark provides a full suite of commercial real estate services to a wide range of clients including some of the world’s largest banks, debt and equity funds, REITs, life insurance companies, brokerages, and investors throughout the United States and Europe. Our team consists of over 600 employees based in New York, Atlanta, Houston, Boca Raton, Kansas City, and Chennai, India.
Job Description: Spring11 is seeking a highly motivated, Asset Management Analyst to join our growing team. The Analyst will be responsible for the management of high-yield debt and equity positions for various bank, REIT, and Private Equity clients.  The position will focus on supporting Asset Management functions for a portfolio primarily made up of ground-up developments and transitional operating properties.  The portfolio spans various commercial real estate property types and regions.

Essential Duties / Responsibilities:
- Supporting the senior asset managers in monitoring each position’s performance relative to underwriting, budget, and covenants within loan documents
- Coordinating with and/or management of various third-parties including servicers, borrowers, lenders, and construction consultants, amongst others
- Managing the draw review process for ground-up construction projects of varying sizes and scopes ranging from single-use, secondary market transactions to high-profile, trophy projects in major metros
- Monitoring performance of transitional/value-add operating properties including performing lease analysis, TI/LC and Renovation draw reviews, and loan covenant testing
- Completing quarterly asset updates for each asset and presenting to client as required
- Re-underwriting each asset on a semi-annual or annual basis and providing support for diligence and underwriting as needed
- Constructing monthly debt waterfalls for cash managed deals, and working alongside the Treasury team to ensure funds are administered properly
- Working collaboratively with Servicing, Insurance, Tax, and other related servicing departments, in order to maintain proper Loan compliance and lien position security
- Performing other ad-hoc duties, including providing periodic underwriting support, as needed

- Bachelor’s Degree in Real Estate, Economics, Finance, or other related field required
- 1-2 years of experience related to commercial real estate industry is preferred
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Must possess the financial and quantitative acumen necessary to make well-reasoned, decisive recommendations, as applicable, to senior management
- Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel
- High attention to detail
- Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
- Ability to work in a fast-paced and quickly changing environment

jobs.title: Analyst, Investment
jobs.description:

- Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate required; Master’s degree in real estate or MBA in Finance preferred
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint
- Strong quantitative, financials analysis and modeling skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

jobs.title: Vice President, Compliance
jobs.description:
Work closely with the Managing Director-Head of Compliance in supporting the firm’s overall governance framework ensuring compliance with regulatory, investor, and internal requirements. This includes: i) federal/state/municipal regulations and requirements for a nationwide mortgage lender and loan servicer, ii) , investor contracts/agreements/guides/obligations as a counterparty to Fannie, Freddie, FHA/Ginne Mae and other lending sources, and iii) Cantor/Newmark policies & procedures.
Definition of Success:
No federal/state/municipal regulatory lapses, penalties, or findings, satisfactory or better audits findings (external and internal),  and no non-compliance findings with corporate policies & procedures.
- Must display a high degree of initiative, task ownership, ability to work with minimal supervision, with an attention to detail.

- Ability to organize and prioritize projects; complete multiple tasks on schedule, and function as a committed team player.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills; must be able to communicate with others at all levels – internally and externally.

- Must be able to research, problem solve, and resolve matters as they arise.

- BA/BS degree in finance, accounting, real estate or other business related field preferred.

- 10 years loan servicing portfolio management experience including knowledge of GSE and CMBS products.

- Strong working knowledge of loan servicing systems and proficiency with MS Office Word and Excel.
- Policies & Procedures: own administration of policies and procedures, including a centralized location providing ease of access, consistent of format/content, and ensuring they are up to date.

- Compliance Deliverables: review new agreements/contracts and Agency Guide updates for recurring compliance deliverables and update our tracking tool as necessary to capture.
- Complete or provide oversight of Agency and HUD/Ginnie Lender and Officer Certifications/Attestations, Financial Reporting, Evidence of Insurance, Limited Power of Attorney, Suspicious Activity Log, Audits, and other deliverables as they arise.

- Coordinate the creation and distribution of Annual Officer’s Certifications for Master Servicers, Life Companies, and other recipient’s as necessary, ensuring deadlines are met per Servicing Agreements.

- Coordinate the distribution of Annual Compliance items including but not limited to; E&O Insurance Coverage, RegAB & USAP Audit Opinion Letter and Financial Statements per Servicing Agreements ensuring NDAs are current where appropriate.

- Coordinate the review of the annual Management Rep Letter for RegAB with the firm’s auditor, senior management, internal legal counsel, and external counsel.

- Ensure authorized representatives are filed and current with our investors, and any necessary notifications of additions are departures are performed within required timelines.

- Reporting: maintain and distribute the Quarterly Compliance Report documenting the status of our compliance efforts.

- Work closely with the Managing Director in supporting the administration of audits/rating reviews including scheduling/planning, tracking deliverables, collecting & reviewing materials, escalating issues/concerns, responding to requests, and follow up on findings/remediation as necessary.

- Regulatory: maintain Regulatory Policy is up to date and communicated to teams to ensure the firm complies with lending, brokering, and servicing licensure requirements. Work with regulatory counsel to ensure we stay current with state and federal requirements, we provide periodic reporting to the appropriate agencies as required, and NMLS properly reflects our compliance status.

- Governance:  Take the lead in managing Corporate Authorities, carry out document retention actions per the Document & Information Governance Policy, compliance with mandatory training is completed by all users, insurance coverage (HUB and Marsh) is renewed annually (up-do-date Insurance Certificates maintained on SharePoint site) and work with the Cantor Tax Department to ensure tax assessments are paid for BPC.

- Manage and develop the GST team resource(s) by delegating down the majority of administrative tasks and assuming a review and approval role.

- Perform periodic Wire Audit of Servicing, Production, Closing and Business Support. and external counterparts and install confidence in compliance framework and abilities.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire des opérations d’affaires — Évaluation et services-conseils, Canada | Business Operations Manager, Canada Valuation & Advisory
jobs.description:
Description du poste (Gestionnaire des opérations d’affaires — Évaluation et services-conseils, Canada) :
Le ou la gestionnaire des opérations d’affaires, Évaluation et services-conseils Canada, relève du directeur général principal — chef des opérations, Canada. Ce poste interagit avec la plupart des fonctions au sein de l’activité d’évaluation et de services-conseils, notamment avec la direction générale, les responsables de marché, les évaluateurs, les équipes des finances, les coordonnateurs régionaux, les administrateurs régionaux, les spécialistes de la facturation ainsi que les coordonnateurs de l’administration de projets. La personne titulaire du poste travaillera également avec les équipes des opérations corporatives, de la comptabilité, des ressources humaines, des affaires juridiques et de l’administration de Newmark.
En collaboration avec les autres gestionnaires des opérations d’affaires de l’équipe Évaluation et services-conseils, cette personne est responsable de l’orientation et de la coordination de l’ensemble des activités non liées au marché. Cela comprend la gestion globale et le soutien fonctionnel des activités d’évaluation, notamment certaines activités de ressources humaines ainsi que les fonctions de coordonnateurs régionaux et de facturation, d’administrateurs régionaux et de coordonnateurs de l’administration de projets.
Principales responsabilités
Pour certains marchés au sein de l’activité Évaluation et services-conseils, les responsabilités essentielles comprennent notamment:
- Superviser les coordonnateurs régionaux, les spécialistes de la facturation, les administrateurs régionaux et les coordonnateurs de l’administration de projets. Veiller à l’exactitude et à la conformité des processus de constatation des revenus, conformément aux politiques internes et aux normes externes. Aider à résoudre les problèmes ou répondre aux questions liées au traitement des revenus.
- Gérer et approuver les feuilles de temps des subordonnés directs à la clôture de chaque période de paie.
- Déménagements de bureaux : remplir les documents administratifs requis pour les employés concernés par un changement de lieu de travail, confirmer que le lieu d’imposition est correctement configuré dans les systèmes et s’assurer que les mises à jour associées au nouvel emplacement sont effectuées.
- Comptes recevables et comptes fournisseurs : fournir des directives aux administrateurs régionaux et aux autres membres de l’équipe concernant le traitement des comptes fournisseurs et les applications liées aux comptes clients, au besoin.
- Travailler directement avec le directeur général principal — chef des opérations, Canada, le vice-président principal mondial des finances pour Évaluation et services-conseils, ainsi qu’avec les autres gestionnaires des opérations d’affaires, dans le cadre de projets spéciaux.
- Vérification des heures des employés rémunérés à l’heure : vérifier les feuilles de temps de tous les employés rémunérés à l’heure afin de s’assurer qu’elles sont complètes et approuvées à la fin de chaque période de paie. Collaborer avec les employés ayant omis des heures ou rencontrant des erreurs de paie, telles que des problèmes fiscaux, de retenues ou de versement de la paie.
- Fournir un soutien ponctuel aux processus de ressources humaines, notamment à l’intégration et au départ des employés.
- Exécuter toute autre tâche connexe qui pourrait être confiée.

Compétences, formation et expérience
- De 7 à 9 années d’expérience pertinente sont requises.
- Une expérience antérieure en supervision ou en gestion constitue un atout.
- Excellentes compétences en communication requises.
- Solides compétences informatiques, y compris la capacité d’apprendre de nouveaux systèmes.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et à travailler avec des intervenants de tous les niveaux hiérarchiques.
- Le bilinguisme français-anglais est souhaité, mais non obligatoire.
- Lieu de travail privilégié : Canada.

Conditions de travail : Conditions normales de travail, sans éléments désagréables particuliers.

Remarque : Les énoncés ci-dessus visent à décrire la nature générale et le niveau des responsabilités exercées dans le cadre de ce poste. Ils ne doivent pas être interprétés comme une liste exhaustive de toutes les responsabilités, tâches et compétences exigées.

Newmark est un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité des chances et de l’action positive. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés sans égard à la race, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe — y compris l’orientation sexuelle et l’identité de genre —, à l’origine nationale, au handicap, au statut d’ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par les lois fédérales, étatiques, provinciales ou locales applicables.

JOB DESCRIPTION (Business Operations Manager, Canada Valuation & Advisory):
The Business Operations Manager, Canada Valuation and Advisory reports to the Senior Managing Director - Head of Operations Canada.  This role interacts with most functions within the Valuation and Advisory business including Executive Leadership, Market Leaders, Appraisers, Finance, Regional Coordinators, Regional Administrators,  Billers, and Project Administration Coordinators . It will also interact with Newmark Corporate Operations, Accounting, Human Resources, Legal, and Administration.  In conjunction with the other Business Operations Managers within the Valuation and Advisory business, this position is responsible for the direction and coordination of all non-market-oriented activities for Valuations and Advisory, including the overall management and functional support activities within Valuation such as certain HR activities, and the Regional Coordinator/Biller and Regional Administrator/ Project Administration Coordinator functions.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES :

Ensures the company’s processes for recognizing revenue are accurate and compliant with both internal policies and external standards. Assist with any issues and questions that arise with processing revenue.

- Responsible for managing and approving time at the close of each pay period for their direct reports.

- Office Relocations: Responsible for completing employee related paperwork for the location change, confirming tax location is correct in the system, and confirming updates for the new location are made in the systems.

- Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable: Provide guidance to Regional Administrators and others regarding Accounts Payable processing and Accounts Receivable applications as questions arise.

- Work directly with the Senior Managing Director - Head of Operations Canada, Global V&A SVP Finance, and other BOMs on special projects.

- Hourly Employee Time Auditing: Responsible for auditing all hourly employee timecards to ensure they are complete and approved at the close of each pay period, work with employees who missed hours and who experience payroll errors (tax issues, deduction issues, not receiving payroll).

- Provide ad hoc support for HR processes, including but not limited to onboarding and offboarding.

- May perform other duties as assigned.

- 7-9 years related experience required

- Previous supervisory or management experience preferred

- Strong communication skills required

- Strong computer skills including ability to learn new systems required

- Ability to multi-task and work with all levels within an organization are required

- Bilingual French/English preferred, but not required

- Location: Canada preferred
